item.title: Red Demons and Lady Demons Shine at Class 6A State Wrestling Championships
item.description: The Red Demons battled through one of the toughest brackets in Kansas and came away with three state placers, finishing 12th overall in the team standings.

item.title: Wildcats Headed to Sioux Falls for The Invitational in 2026, 2027
item.description: Kansas State Wildcats women’s basketball will take part in the 2026 and 2027 editions of The Invitational at the Sanford Pentagon in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, adding two high-profile nonconference matchups to its future schedules.

item.title: Corn Growers Enter New Season Facing Tight Margins Despite Strong Exports
item.description: As farmers move deeper into the winter planning season, U.S. corn growers are taking stock of the 2025 harvest and looking ahead to spring planting under continued financial pressure.

item.title: Kiowa County Memorial Hospital Opens Mental Health Program for Older Adults
item.description: Greensburg – Kiowa County Memorial Hospital has partnered with Senior Life Solutions to help older adults who are experiencing symptoms of depression, anxiety, or other mental challenges often associated with aging.

item.title: Royals Sign Veteran Outfielder Starling Marte to One-Year Deal
item.description: The Kansas City Royals added a proven veteran presence to their roster Tuesday, announcing the signing of outfielder Starling Marte to a one-year Major League contract. Marte will wear No. 0 for Kansas City.

item.title: Kelly Urges Congress to Approve Year-Round E15 Sales Nationwide
item.description: As uncertainty continues to cloud agricultural trade markets and fuel prices remain elevated, Gov. Laura Kelly is calling on Congress to authorize year-round sales of E15 gasoline nationwide, arguing the move would strengthen Kansas agriculture and provide relief at the pump.
